summary: Incomplete deliverable. Python script (aggregator.py) is well-written with good error handling and modularity, but core requirements unmet: (1) No tests provided—task mandates red/green TDD, write failing test first; (2) No fixture files created (fixtures/run1-junit.xml, fixtures/run2-results.json referenced in workflow but not included); (3) No act harness or act-result.txt (required artifact); (4) Workflow steps reference non-existent fixture paths; (5) Task requires all tests run through act with output capture and assertions—entirely absent. The script itself is production-ready, but deliverable is ~40% complete.
